s.SUB_REVIEW_ID, s.REVIEW_ID AS SUB_REVIEW_FK, s.CATEGORY, s.ITEM_NAME, s.SUB_RATING, s.SUB_COMMENT, s.LOCATION_BRAND, s.IS_CERTIFIED, s.TAGS

SELECT SEQ_DAILY_REVIEW.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO DAILY_REVIEWS ( REVIEW_ID, USER_ID, REVIEW_DATE, TOTAL_RATING, MOOD_TAGS, OVERALL_COMMENT, MAIN_IMAGE_URL, IS_PUBLIC ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{totalRating}, #{moodTags}, #{overallComment}, #{mainImageUrl}, NVL(#{isPublic, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y') )

INSERT INTO SUB_REVIEWS ( SUB_REVIEW_ID, REVIEW_ID, CATEGORY, ITEM_NAME, SUB_RATING, SUB_COMMENT, LOCATION_BRAND, IS_CERTIFIED, TAGS ) VALUES ( SEQ_SUB_REVIEW.NEXTVAL, #{reviewId}, #{category}, #{itemName}, #{subRating}, #{subComment}, #{locationBrand}, #{isCertified}, #{tags} )

SELECT SR.SUB_REVIEW_ID, SR.REVIEW_ID,
/* 부모 데일리 리뷰 작성 날짜 */ DR.REVIEW_DATE AS REVIEW_DATE,
SR.CATEGORY, SR.ITEM_NAME, SR.SUB_RATING, SR.SUB_COMMENT, SR.LOCATION_BRAND, SR.IS_CERTIFIED, SR.TAGS
FROM SUB_REVIEWS SR
JOIN DAILY_REVIEWS DR ON SR.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID
WHERE DR.USER_ID = #{userId}
ORDER BY DR.REVIEW_DATE DESC, SR.SUB_REVIEW_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE DAILY_REVIEWS SET TOTAL_RATING = #{totalRating}, MOOD_TAGS = #{moodTags}, OVERALL_COMMENT = #{overallComment}, REVIEW_DATE = TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{reviewDate}, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), MAIN_IMAGE_URL = #{mainImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IS_PUBLIC = NVL(#{isPublic, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IS_PUBLIC) WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
mapper.select:
SELECT d.REVIEW_ID, d.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, u.PROFILE_IMG AS AUTHOR_PROFILE_IMG, u.USER_LEVEL AS AUTHOR_LEVEL, u.STREAK_COUNT AS AUTHOR_STREAK_COUNT, TO_CHAR(d.REVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REVIEW_DATE, d.TOTAL_RATING, d.MOOD_TAGS, d.OVERALL_COMMENT, d.MAIN_IMAGE_URL, d.IS_PUBLIC, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIKES l WHERE l.REVIEW_ID = d.REVIEW_ID) AS LIKE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.REVIEW_ID = d.REVIEW_ID) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM DAILY_REVIEWS d JOIN USERS u ON d.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE d.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SUB_REVIEWS s WHERE s.REVIEW_ID = d.REVIEW_ID AND (LOWER(s.CATEGORY) = LOWER(#{category}) OR (LOWER(#{category}) = 'place' AND s.CATEGORY = '장소') OR (LOWER(#{category}) = 'item' AND s.CATEGORY = '아이템') OR (LOWER(#{category}) = 'transport' AND s.CATEGORY = '이동수단') OR (LOWER(#{category}) = 'content' AND s.CATEGORY = '콘텐츠')) )
ORDER BY d.TOTAL_RATING DESC, d.REVIEW_DATE DESC, d.REVIEW_ID DESC
ORDER BY d.REVIEW_DATE DESC, d.REVIEW_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DAILY_REVIEWS d WHERE d.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SUB_REVIEWS s WHERE s.REVIEW_ID = d.REVIEW_ID AND (LOWER(s.CATEGORY) = LOWER(#{category}) OR (LOWER(#{category}) = 'place' AND s.CATEGORY = '장소') OR (LOWER(#{category}) = 'item' AND s.CATEGORY = '아이템') OR (LOWER(#{category}) = 'transport' AND s.CATEGORY = '이동수단') OR (LOWER(#{category}) = 'content' AND s.CATEGORY = '콘텐츠')) )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CATEGORY = 'place' THEN 1 END) AS placeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CATEGORY = 'item' THEN 1 END) AS itemCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CATEGORY = 'transport' THEN 1 END) AS transportCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CATEGORY = 'content' THEN 1 END) AS contentCount FROM SUB_REVIEWS
